moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make chart history
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's duet 'Rein Me In' has become the longest-running UK Number 1 single ever, spending a record-breaking 19 non-consecutive weeks at the top of the Official Singles Chart as of July 31, 2026.

angles.name: Record Breakers
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is officially the UK's longest-running No.1 single ever with 19 weeks. Who saw that coming? #UKCharts

angles.name: The Unstoppable Duet
angles.copy: 19 weeks at Number 1! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean have smashed a 73-year record with 'Rein Me In'. An absolute phenomenon.
